paragraph: Saddle River is a single-tier market. Eighteen single-family sales over six months at a median of $2,760,000, and the typical sale is a five-bedroom colonial with four or five full baths. Prices ran from $1,160,000 to $5,612,500, so the median is the number to anchor on. The sale-to-list ratio sits at 0.97 with about 22 percent of homes going above asking and a median of 31 days on market. That means sellers here are generally okay with waiting for the right buyer rather than pricing to move fast, and you'll usually have room to negotiate. No month in the series had more than five closings, so the monthly medians are too thin to read as a trend. Work the six-month picture instead, and if the town follows the usual Bergen arc, expect closing volume to thin out in deep winter.
